Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.agui.sdk

Class AGUINodeOutput.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.agui.sdk.AGUINodeOutput.Builder
Enclosing class:
AGUINodeOutput<State extends AgentState>
public static class AGUINodeOutput.Builder extends Object
Builder for AGUINodeOutput instances, used to accumulate the AG-UI Events to be carried by the resulting output before binding them to a node id and state via build(String, AgentState).
